rewardDetails.name: Liquidity Hub intrinsic APY
rewardDetails.description: The native yield earned by supplying the underlying asset to the Venus Liquidity Hub. vhTokens accrue this yield through a rising redemption rate rather than claimable rewards — you receive it automatically when you withdraw.
